llm.reply:
The trials retrieved all target thyroid cancer rather than a condition explicitly labelled carcinoma not otherwise specified, so they only partly answer the question. The retrieved disease records do include several NOS carcinoma concepts.

## Retrieved Thyroid Trials

One trial is Radioimmunotherapy With or Without Chemotherapy Plus Peripheral Stem Cell Transplantation in Treating Patients With Thyroid Cancer [1]. Another is Thalidomide in Treating Patients With Thyroid Cancer [2]. A third is Irinotecan in Treating Patients With Metastatic or Inoperable Thyroid Cancer [3]. Others are Tanespimycin in Treating Patients With Inoperable Locoregionally Advanced or Metastatic Thyroid Cancer [4] and Suberoylanilide Hydroxamic Acid in Treating Patients With Metastatic and/or Locally Advanced or Locally Recurrent Thyroid Cancer [5].

## Related NOS Disease Concepts

One matching disease concept is Medullary Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [6]. Renal concepts include Advanced Renal Cell Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [10]. Another is Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [11]. A cervical concept is Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [13].

## Supporting Literature

A population-based breast cancer study, PMID 15365566, is linked to this subject [16]. It reported the poorest 5-year relative survival for NOS carcinoma among the microscopically confirmed categories [17: "ranged from 66% (95% CI 61-71) for NOS carcinoma to 95% (95% CI 90-100) for special types"]. Tumour morphology remained a significant independent survival predictor [17: "Morphology and hormone receptor status were confirmed as significant survival predictors"].

A fifth is Suberoylanilide Hydroxamic Acid in Treating Patients With Metastatic and/or Locally Advanced or Locally Recurrent Thyroid Cancer [5].

## Related NOS Disease Concepts

The graph holds a disease concept named Medullary Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [6]. It also holds Primary Intraosseous Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified, Derived from Odontogenic Cyst [7]. A related record is Infiltrating duct carcinoma of breast [8]. Another is Primary Intraosseous Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified, Derived from Odontogenic Keratocyst [9]. There is also Advanced Renal Cell Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [10]. Another is Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [11]. Another is Locally Advanced Renal Cell Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [12]. The last is Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [13].

## Supporting Literature

The MedGen record is titled Medullary Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [15]. One related paper is Prognostic value of morphology and hormone receptor status in breast cancer - a population-based study. [14]. Its PMID is 15365566 [16]. In that study, breast NOS carcinoma had the lowest survival among the tumour types with microscopic confirmation [17: "ranged from 66% (95% CI 61-71) for NOS carcinoma to 95% (95% CI 90-100) for special types"].
